PROCEDURES NOTE

Transcatheter aortic valve replacement was performed via transfemoral access for severe
native aortic stenosis in a patient felt to be at high surgical risk.

An XT valve was advanced under fluoroscopic guidance and deployed across the native
annulus in satisfactory position with mild paravalvular regurgitation on completion
angiography.

Implant Size: 26

Predischarge echocardiography showed the mean gradient is 9 mmHg with an effective orifice
area of 1.7 cm2.
